about.title: About The Rainbow Hub
about.metaDescription: Discover how The Rainbow Hub creates fast, mobile-first quizzes, calculates results and keeps entertainment claims in perspective.
about.updated: Independent quizzes built for quick, thoughtful play.

sections.heading: What The Rainbow Hub Is
paragraphs: The Rainbow Hub is an independent quiz website for people who enjoy quick challenges, surprising questions and results that are easy to understand. It is designed for a worldwide audience and works across phones, tablets and desktop computers.

The library includes memory, language, visual reasoning, practical judgement, university-inspired and entertainment prediction quizzes. Some challenges have right and wrong answers. Others match preferences to a fictional profile or estimate. Each quiz explains its own format before the result is shown.

sections.heading: How A Quiz Works
list: Every current quiz uses the same focused ten-question flow, with its own theme, question types and result experience.
Answers advance automatically, and correctness stays hidden until the final result so the challenge is not spoiled.
Progress is stored locally in the browser for up to 30 minutes so a recent session can be restored after a refresh.
After question ten, a short preparation state reviews the answers before the result-ready screen appears.
At the end, scored quizzes show the final result and can provide a detailed review of incorrect answers and correct choices.

sections.heading: How Results Are Calculated
paragraphs: Knowledge and entrance-style quizzes calculate results from the answer key stored for that quiz. Preference-based experiences use disclosed scoring rules to match answers to fictional profiles or entertainment estimates. Speed does not change a score unless a quiz explicitly says otherwise.
A result describes performance inside that particular question set. It is not transferable to an official examination, qualification, diagnosis, aptitude score or admission decision.

sections.heading: Our Editorial Standard
list: Questions should have one defensible answer whenever correctness is scored.
Prompts and answer choices should remain readable without zooming on a small phone.
Worldwide English should avoid unnecessary local laws, measurements, emergency numbers or regional protocols inside quiz questions.
Professional themes should test general reasoning without presenting treatment instructions or pretending to replace formal training.
Visuals should add useful information, remain clearly labelled and avoid revealing the answer accidentally.
Results should be positive and engaging without overstating what a short online quiz can establish.

sections.heading: Challenge Claims And Social Proof
paragraphs: Headlines such as “Only 7% Pass” are entertainment hooks rather than independently verified population statistics unless a quiz clearly states otherwise. Social-proof figures are presentation counters and should not be interpreted as audited unique-user totals.
We use this style of wording to create a playful challenge, not to make scientific or academic claims. The final score is still calculated from the answers submitted in that session.

sections.heading: AI, Portraits And Predictions
paragraphs: Some experiences use AI-themed language or original generated artwork. A title may describe the entertainment concept, but the result is not a factual prediction about a real person or future event.

Where a quiz matches answers to a prepared portrait or profile library, its About This Quiz section explains that method. We do not ask visitors to upload a face photograph to receive a standard quiz result.

sections.heading: Advertising And Free Access
paragraphs: The site is free to use and may show rewarded advertising before a quiz begins, before a result is revealed or before an optional detailed breakdown. Advertising, analytics and measurement services help fund hosting, content development and technical maintenance.
An advertisement does not change the answers, score, profile or result. If no rewarded ad is genuinely available after the permitted attempts, the quiz flow provides its configured fallback.

sections.heading: Independent And Unofficial
paragraphs: The Rainbow Hub is not an examination board, university, school, healthcare provider, employer or professional licensing body. University and career names describe the theme of a quiz only unless a page explicitly states a formal relationship.
If you find an unclear question, a broken visual, a translation issue or a result that does not match the published rules, please send the page address and details through our Contact page.

contact.title: Contact The Rainbow Hub
contact.metaDescription: Contact The Rainbow Hub about quiz corrections, privacy rights, accessibility, advertising or technical problems.
contact.updated: Send one clear message and include the page address whenever possible.

sections.heading: Email Us
paragraphs: Use the email address below for general support, editorial questions, accessibility feedback, privacy requests, advertising queries or technical problems. We read every legitimate message, although response times depend on the type and complexity of the request.
Please do not send passwords, identity documents, medical records, financial information or other sensitive material unless we specifically request a limited item to verify a lawful privacy request.

sections.heading: Report A Quiz Problem
list: Give the quiz title and the full page address.
Include the question number shown on screen.
Quote the prompt and the answer you believe needs review.
Explain whether the issue concerns accuracy, wording, translation, accessibility or a visual.
Attach a screenshot if the layout or image is important to the report.

sections.heading: Privacy Requests
paragraphs: State the privacy right you want to exercise and the country, state or region from which you are making the request. Because the site does not use visitor accounts, we may hold little information that can be linked directly to you.

We may ask for limited information to locate relevant records or verify that a request concerns you. We will use verification information only for handling the request and will respond within the period required by applicable law.

sections.heading: Accessibility Feedback
paragraphs: Tell us what you were trying to do, what prevented you from completing it, the device and browser used, and any assistive technology involved. This helps us reproduce the issue and prioritise a practical fix.
If a quiz visual cannot be understood with your access needs, include the question number so we can review the alternative wording or presentation.

sections.heading: Advertising And Technical Issues
list: Include the page address, approximate date and time, country, device and browser.
Say whether the issue occurred before a quiz, during a question, on the result-ready screen or during the final reveal.
For an advert problem, describe what appeared without clicking or sending any suspicious information.
For a loading issue, say whether refreshing restored the saved session.
Screenshots or a short screen recording are useful when they do not expose private information.

sections.heading: Rights, Safety And Abuse
paragraphs: You may also contact us about intellectual-property concerns, unlawful content, security reports or misuse of the site. Identify the affected material precisely and explain the basis of the report.
This inbox is not an emergency, medical or crisis service. If there is an immediate risk to health or safety, contact the appropriate emergency or professional service where you are located.

accessibility.title: Accessibility Statement
accessibility.metaDescription: Read The Rainbow Hub's accessibility goals, supported features, known limitations and route for reporting a barrier.

sections.heading: Our Commitment
paragraphs: The Rainbow Hub aims to make its core quiz and information-page experiences usable by as many people as reasonably possible, across common screen sizes, browsers, input methods and assistive technologies.

We use the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 Level AA as a practical design target. This is an ongoing goal rather than a claim that every page or third-party component has been independently certified.

sections.heading: What We Currently Support
list: Responsive layouts tested on small phones, tablets and desktop screens without horizontal scrolling.
Semantic headings, landmarks, links, buttons and form-like answer controls.
Keyboard access and visible focus treatments for the main navigation and quiz actions.
Text alternatives or accessible labels for informative quiz images and visual question groups where available.
Colour choices designed to maintain readable contrast, with answer states that do not rely only on colour.
Reduced animation for visitors whose device requests reduced motion.
Plain-language results and a text review of missed answers on scored quizzes.

sections.heading: Timed And Memory Content
paragraphs: Some memory questions intentionally show study material for a limited time because recall is the subject of the challenge. Timed study cards display a visual progress indicator, and exposure times are chosen to allow the material to be read before it disappears.
A small number of manual study interactions wait for the visitor to confirm readiness. Answer-selection speed itself does not determine the score unless the quiz clearly says otherwise.

sections.heading: Visual Questions
paragraphs: Vision, spatial and pattern quizzes may depend on colour, shape, position, rotation or line tracking. Those mechanics cannot always be reproduced fully as text without changing what the question tests.

We aim to provide useful accessible labels and keep visuals large enough to inspect on mobile. Some visual puzzles may nevertheless be less suitable for screen-reader users or people with particular visual impairments.

sections.heading: Rewarded Advertising
paragraphs: Rewarded advertisements are supplied through third-party technology and may introduce controls or media outside our direct presentation layer. The quiz includes unavailable-ad fallbacks, but the accessibility of an individual advert is controlled by its provider and advertiser.
If an advert prevents keyboard, touch or assistive-technology access to the next step, report the page, device, browser and approximate time so we can investigate the placement.

sections.heading: Known Limitations
list: Some visual puzzles require sight and cannot offer an equivalent non-visual challenge without changing the answer.
Automatically timed memory material may not suit every reading or cognitive-access need.
Third-party consent and advertising interfaces may not perfectly match the accessibility of the site itself.
Generated or decorative artwork may have limited descriptive value when it does not affect the result.
Older browser versions may not support every responsive or focus enhancement.

sections.heading: How To Report A Barrier
paragraphs: Contact us with the exact page address, what you were trying to do, what happened, your device and browser, and any assistive technology used. Please include the quiz and question number when relevant.
We will review accessibility feedback in good faith, prioritise barriers affecting the core journey and provide an alternative format where one is practical.

privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy-policy.metaDescription: Learn what information The Rainbow Hub collects, why it is used, who may receive it and the privacy choices available to visitors.

sections.heading: Scope And Who We Are
paragraphs: This Privacy Policy applies to The Rainbow Hub website at therainbowhub.com, its quiz pages and the information pages linked from the site footer. The Rainbow Hub operates the site and determines how information described in this policy is used.

The site does not currently offer visitor accounts. You can normally take a quiz without directly providing a name, postal address, telephone number or email address. Contact details are collected only when you choose to send us a message.

sections.heading: Information Collected Automatically
list: Technical data such as IP address, browser type, operating system, device type, screen size, language and approximate location derived from an IP address.
Usage data such as page views, referring addresses, campaign parameters, quiz events, button interactions, session timing and whether a result was reached.
Advertising and measurement identifiers such as cookie IDs, pixels, tag identifiers, consent signals and device or browser identifiers used by participating providers.
Diagnostic information such as loading failures, ad availability, browser errors, security events and aggregated performance measurements.
Quiz interaction data stored in your own browser, including selected answers, current question, reveal state and the time at which progress was last updated.

sections.heading: Information You Provide
paragraphs: If you email us, we receive your email address, message and any files or information you choose to include. If you make a privacy, accessibility, intellectual-property or security request, we may also receive limited information needed to understand or verify that request.
Please avoid sending sensitive personal information that is not necessary. Quiz answers are not designed to collect a medical history, official exam record or identity document.

sections.heading: Local Quiz Progress
paragraphs: Quiz progress is saved in local storage on the device and browser being used. This can include answers, the current question, preparation and reveal states, result state and whether the saved session has already recorded the relevant rewarded-ad event.

A saved quiz session is eligible for restoration for 30 minutes from its last update. Expired progress is removed when the quiz is opened again. You can remove it sooner by clearing site data in your browser or using a restart control where provided.

sections.heading: How We Use Information
list: To deliver quiz questions, restore recent progress and calculate the requested result.
To operate rewarded advertising and continue the quiz when the ad is completed or genuinely unavailable.
To measure visits, campaigns, quiz completion and site performance.
To detect fraud, abuse, security incidents and technical failures.
To improve layouts, question quality, translations and user experience.
To respond to messages and exercise or defend legal rights.
To comply with legal duties and enforce the Terms of Use.

sections.heading: Legal Bases Where Required
paragraphs: Where privacy law requires a legal basis, processing may rely on consent, legitimate interests, performance of a requested service, compliance with law or protection of legal rights. The appropriate basis depends on the activity and where you are located.

Consent is used for non-essential advertising or measurement where required. Legitimate interests may support site security, basic audience measurement, error diagnosis and improvement, provided those interests are not overridden by your rights. You may withdraw consent through the available consent controls without affecting earlier lawful processing.

sections.heading: Advertising, Analytics And Measurement
paragraphs: The site uses or may use Assertive Yield, Google Publisher Tags and Google advertising services to deliver and measure advertising, including rewarded formats. It also uses Google Analytics or Google tag and Meta Pixel to measure page visits, campaigns and selected quiz events.

These providers may receive technical, usage, advertising and consent information and may set or read cookies or similar identifiers according to their own policies and your available choices. An ad provider may combine information from this site with information from other services where permitted.

sections.heading: Who May Receive Information
list: Advertising, analytics, campaign-measurement and consent-management providers.
Website hosting, content delivery, security, debugging and technical service providers.
Professional advisers, insurers, auditors or prospective transaction partners where reasonably necessary.
Regulators, courts, law enforcement or other parties where disclosure is required by law or necessary to protect rights, safety and security.
A successor operator if all or part of the site or its assets is reorganised, sold or transferred.
after: We do not maintain a database of visitor account profiles because the site does not currently provide accounts. Certain advertising disclosures may be treated as a sale, sharing or targeted-advertising activity under some privacy laws even when no money is paid for the information.

sections.heading: International Processing
paragraphs: The site is available internationally, and providers may process information in countries other than the one where you live. Those countries may have different privacy laws.

Where applicable law requires safeguards for an international transfer, the responsible provider or operator may rely on an adequacy decision, approved contractual clauses or another lawful transfer mechanism.

sections.heading: Retention
paragraphs: Local quiz progress is designed to expire after 30 minutes. Contact messages are kept only as long as needed to respond, keep an appropriate record and meet legal or security requirements.

Analytics, advertising, hosting and security providers apply their own retention settings and policies. Aggregated or de-identified information may be retained for longer when it can no longer reasonably identify an individual.

sections.heading: Your Privacy Choices And Rights
list: Use the consent interface shown in your region to accept, reject or adjust available non-essential purposes.
Block or delete cookies and local storage through your browser settings, understanding that saved progress or advertising features may then stop working.
Adjust advertising preferences through Google, Meta and other provider controls where available.
Ask for access, correction, deletion, restriction, portability or an objection where your local law provides that right.
Withdraw consent where processing is based on consent.
Opt out of sale, sharing or targeted advertising where that right applies and the activity falls within the relevant legal definition.
Complain to the data-protection or privacy regulator responsible for your location.
after: Send a request through the Contact page and identify your country or state. We may need limited information to locate relevant data or verify a request. Applicable exceptions may allow or require us to retain certain information. You will not be discriminated against for exercising a privacy right.

sections.heading: Children's Privacy
paragraphs: The site is intended for a general audience and is not directed to children under 13. We do not knowingly ask a child under 13 to provide personal information through an account or profile.

If you believe a child has sent personal information to us, contact us with enough detail to locate the message so we can review and remove it where appropriate. Additional age and consent requirements may apply in some countries.

sections.heading: Security
paragraphs: We use reasonable technical and organisational measures intended to protect the site and information handled through it. No internet transmission, advertising system or storage method can be guaranteed completely secure.

Please report a suspected security problem through the Contact page and do not publicly disclose details that could put visitors at further risk before we have had a reasonable opportunity to investigate.

sections.heading: Changes And Contact
paragraphs: We may update this policy when site features, providers or legal requirements change. The date at the top identifies the latest published version. Material changes may also be highlighted through an appropriate notice.
For privacy questions or requests, use the email address on the Contact page. Include your location and the right or concern involved, but do not send identity documents unless requested.

cookie-policy.title: Cookie Policy
cookie-policy.metaDescription: Understand how The Rainbow Hub uses cookies, local storage, pixels, advertising tags and similar browser technologies.

sections.heading: What This Policy Covers
paragraphs: This policy explains technologies that store information on a device or read information already stored there. These include browser cookies, local storage, pixels, tags, scripts and advertising identifiers.

The technologies used can vary by location, consent choice, browser, provider and whether an advertisement is available. The Privacy Policy explains how resulting personal information is handled more broadly.

sections.heading: Essential And Security Technologies
paragraphs: Some technologies support routing, security, consent records and basic delivery of the site. They may be needed to provide a requested feature, remember a privacy choice, prevent fraud or keep the service reliable.
Blocking all storage or scripts can prevent a consent preference, quiz session or rewarded advertisement from operating as expected.

sections.heading: Functional Quiz Storage
paragraphs: The quiz engine uses browser local storage to retain recent progress. A saved record can contain selected answers, the current question, preparation and reveal states, result state, locale and the time of the last update.

Progress is valid for up to 30 minutes and is then removed when that quiz is opened again. Local storage remains on the device unless the site or visitor removes it; unlike a traditional cookie, it is not automatically sent with every network request.

sections.heading: Analytics Technologies
paragraphs: Google Analytics or Google tag may measure page visits, traffic sources, device characteristics and selected interactions. These measurements help identify errors, understand campaign performance and improve quiz completion.
Analytics identifiers and retention depend on the configuration, consent signal and provider rules that apply to the visit.

sections.heading: Advertising Technologies
paragraphs: Assertive Yield, Google Publisher Tags, Google advertising services and participating advertisers may use cookies or similar identifiers to request, deliver, limit, secure and measure advertisements, including rewarded ads.

Depending on your location and choices, advertising may be contextual or personalised. Providers may measure whether an ad was available, displayed, completed or closed and may use fraud-prevention signals.

sections.heading: Campaign And Social Measurement
paragraphs: Meta Pixel may receive page-view and selected quiz-event information used to understand advertising referrals and campaign outcomes. A rewarded-ad completion can trigger a custom QuizStart event once for the saved quiz session after the reward is granted and the ad is closed.
Campaign addresses may also include parameters identifying the source, campaign, placement or advertisement. These parameters can be measured with the visit.

sections.heading: Consent And Your Controls
list: Use the consent interface shown for your region to manage the purposes and providers offered there.
Use browser settings to view, block or delete cookies and site data.
Use private browsing, tracking-prevention tools or supported provider opt-out controls.
Clear local storage if you do not want a recent quiz session restored.
Review Google, Meta and other advertising-provider privacy settings where available.
after: Where consent is legally required, continuing to browse is not treated by this policy as consent to non-essential cookies. Withdrawing consent does not make earlier processing unlawful, and strictly necessary or exempt technologies may continue to operate.

sections.heading: How Long Technologies Last
paragraphs: Quiz-progress storage is designed around a 30-minute restoration window. Consent, security, analytics and advertising technologies may be session-based or remain for longer periods determined by their purpose, configuration and provider.

Because third-party identifiers and durations can change, provider tools and notices are the most current source for an individual cookie. We review this page when the site's main technology categories change.

sections.heading: Contact
paragraphs: For questions about cookies or similar technologies used on The Rainbow Hub, contact us through the Contact page and include your country, browser and the privacy choice or technology involved.

terms-of-use.title: Terms of Use
terms-of-use.metaDescription: Read the terms for using The Rainbow Hub quizzes, rewarded advertising, results, artwork and other site features.

sections.heading: Agreement To These Terms
paragraphs: These Terms of Use apply when you access or use The Rainbow Hub at therainbowhub.com. By using the site, you agree to these terms and the policies linked from the footer. If you do not agree, do not use the site.
If you use the site on behalf of an organisation, you confirm that you have authority to accept these terms for that organisation.

sections.heading: Age And Audience
paragraphs: The site is intended for a general audience and is not directed to children under 13. If you are not legally able to agree to online terms where you live, use the site only with the involvement of a parent or legal guardian.
Some quiz themes concern mortality, professional scenarios or relationships and may not suit every visitor. Choose whether to participate based on your own circumstances.

sections.heading: Entertainment And General Learning
paragraphs: Quizzes, results, profiles, estimates, answer reviews, pass-rate headlines and social-proof counters are provided for entertainment, curiosity and general learning. They are not official tests, credentials, admissions decisions or professional assessments.
Do not rely on the site as medical, psychological, educational, employment, legal, financial, safety or relationship advice. The Disclaimer gives additional examples and limitations.

sections.heading: Rewarded Advertising
paragraphs: The site may ask you to view a short rewarded advertisement before a quiz begins, before a final result becomes available or before an optional detailed breakdown. The button and supporting text identify that exchange before the request is made.

Ad availability is controlled by third-party systems and is not guaranteed. Early closure may return you to the same gate. Genuine unavailability is handled through the quiz's configured retry and fallback process.

sections.heading: Permitted Use
list: Use the site for personal, lawful and non-commercial quiz participation.
Share a normal link to a public page without misrepresenting your relationship with the site.
Use answer reviews for personal learning and discussion.
Report suspected errors, accessibility barriers or security issues responsibly.

sections.heading: Prohibited Use
list: Do not interfere with security, advertising, consent, scoring, availability or normal site operation.
Do not automate requests, scrape the quiz database or reproduce substantial content without permission or a lawful exception.
Do not use the site to harm, deceive, harass, discriminate against or make consequential decisions about another person.
Do not introduce malware, probe systems without permission or attempt to gain unauthorised access.
Do not present a quiz result as an official qualification, diagnosis, admissions outcome or verified fact.

sections.heading: Intellectual Property
paragraphs: The site design, branding, quiz wording, question arrangements, result copy, code, graphics and original artwork are owned by the site operator or used under licence. These terms give you a limited right to use the public site for its intended purpose; they do not transfer ownership.
Third-party names, marks, adverts and materials remain the property of their respective owners. Reporting a concern does not require you to surrender any legal right.

sections.heading: No University Or Professional Affiliation
paragraphs: Oxford, Cambridge, Harvard and professional role names are used as quiz themes. Unless explicitly stated in writing, The Rainbow Hub is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by or officially connected to a university, school, admissions office, examination board, healthcare organisation, employer or licensing body.
Questions are written for a general worldwide audience and do not reproduce a named institution's actual admissions process or local professional protocol.

sections.heading: Third-Party Services And Links
paragraphs: Advertising, analytics, hosting, consent and external links may be provided by third parties under their own terms and privacy notices. We do not control every advertisement, external page or third-party interface.
A link or advertisement does not mean that we endorse the destination. Use reasonable care before providing information, making a purchase or relying on third-party content.

sections.heading: Availability And Changes
paragraphs: We may add, update, suspend or remove quizzes, questions, translations, results, artwork and site features. We do not guarantee that the site, a particular advert or saved progress will always be available, uninterrupted or error-free.
We may restrict access where reasonably necessary to protect the site, visitors, providers or legal rights.

sections.heading: Disclaimers And Liability
paragraphs: The site is provided on an “as is” and “as available” basis to the extent permitted by law. We do not promise that every answer, translation, estimate, profile or result will be complete, current or suitable for your purpose.

To the fullest extent permitted by law, the site operator is not responsible for indirect, incidental, special, consequential or punitive loss arising from use of, or inability to use, the site. Nothing in these terms excludes liability that cannot legally be excluded or limits mandatory consumer rights.

sections.heading: Applicable Law And Severability
paragraphs: These terms operate subject to the laws that apply to the site operator and to any mandatory consumer protections that apply where you live. Nothing here requires a consumer to give up a right that local law does not allow them to waive.
If a provision is found unenforceable, the remaining provisions continue to apply. A delay in enforcing a provision is not a waiver of the right to enforce it later.

sections.heading: Changes And Contact
paragraphs: We may update these terms as the site or applicable requirements change. The latest version applies from the date shown above; material changes may also be highlighted through an appropriate notice.
Questions about these terms can be sent through the Contact page.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.metaDescription: Understand the limits of The Rainbow Hub's scores, estimates, professional themes, AI-style experiences and challenge claims.

sections.heading: Entertainment First
paragraphs: The Rainbow Hub publishes quizzes for entertainment, curiosity, self-reflection and general learning. They are designed to feel polished and engaging, but they are not formal assessment instruments.
A result is based on the finite questions and scoring rules inside that quiz. It should be enjoyed as feedback about that session, not treated as a verified fact about a person.

sections.heading: Scores, Profiles And Percentages
paragraphs: Scores, pass bands, profile labels, strongest areas, estimates and chemistry percentages are broad quiz outputs. They do not establish intelligence, aptitude, personality, educational potential, professional competence, health, life expectancy or future outcomes.
Results can be affected by language, device, visual access, reading speed, interruptions, familiarity with the format and the particular questions selected.

sections.heading: Intelligence And Academic Quizzes
paragraphs: Intelligence, grammar, memory, vision and university-inspired quizzes are not standardised or supervised tests. They cannot provide an official IQ score, language qualification, cognitive assessment, admission result or evidence of eligibility.
Oxford, Cambridge, Harvard and similar names describe a theme only. The quizzes are not created, reviewed, approved or endorsed by those institutions.

sections.heading: Medical And Professional Themes
paragraphs: Nursing, midwifery, paramedic, vision, chef and mechanic quizzes use general scenarios for entertainment and learning. They do not provide clinical care, diagnosis, treatment, safety certification, trade advice or professional training.

Do not use a quiz answer in place of current local guidance, formal education, an employer's procedure or advice from a qualified professional. For an urgent health or safety concern, contact the appropriate local professional or emergency service.

sections.heading: Predictions And AI-Themed Experiences
paragraphs: Years-left and relationship quizzes cannot predict death, lifespan, marriage or the identity of a future partner. Their estimates, portraits and profiles are fictional entertainment outputs based on the choices submitted.

AI-themed wording describes the creative experience and does not mean the site has discovered a real person or certain future event. Where a prepared artwork or profile library is used, the quiz's own About section explains the matching method.

sections.heading: Challenge And Popularity Claims
paragraphs: Headlines such as “Only 7% Pass” are entertainment-style challenge hooks unless the page expressly identifies a validated study or independently audited result set. They should not be read as population statistics.
Figures describing how many people have taken a quiz are social-proof presentation counters and may not represent audited unique individuals, completed attempts or a scientific sample.

sections.heading: Accuracy, Updates And Translations
paragraphs: We aim for one defensible answer in scored questions and natural wording in each supported language. Errors, ambiguities, broken visuals or translation problems can still occur.
Questions, answer keys, scoring rules, translations, artwork and result copy may be corrected or improved. A previous result may therefore differ from a later version of the same quiz.

sections.heading: Advertising And External Content
paragraphs: Advertisements and external links are supplied by third parties and do not affect the quiz score or profile. The appearance of an advert or link does not constitute an endorsement.
We are not responsible for claims, products, availability or privacy practices on a third-party destination. Review its information before relying on it or providing personal details.

sections.heading: Use Your Own Judgement
paragraphs: Do not use a Rainbow Hub result to make an important decision about health, safety, education, admissions, employment, finances, legal rights, relationships or another person's ability.
If a formal answer matters, consult the relevant institution, official testing provider or qualified professional. Questions about a quiz can be reported through the Contact page.
